text: Per BMW AG's report for financial year 2025, the only holders of direct or indirect voting-rights stakes exceeding 10% in the listed company are Stefan Quandt (0.2% direct, 27.5% indirect, via AQTON vehicles) and Susanne Klatten (0.2% direct, 22.3% indirect); no state or state-fund holder is listed.
short: BMW AG is Frankfurt-listed; its >10% voting-rights holders are Stefan Quandt and Susanne Klatten.

source.name: BMW Group Report 2025 (BMW AG), 'List of investments at 31 December 2025' (p. 351) / 'Disclosures Relevant for Takeovers' (p. 267)
source.note: Trailing digits are the table's footnote markers (27.5% footnote 2, 22.3% footnote 5). The page header reads 'the following direct or indirect holdings exceeding 10% of the voting rights at the end of the reporting period were held at the stated reporting date'.
